scientific_limitations: The marked limit requires deterministic cycle-power hosts with m/log(n) tending to infinity and m/n tending to zero.
It concerns three-vertex tree components and does not assert higher-order shape laws, connectivity, or fixed-bandwidth behavior.
The scalar three-component Poisson limit and extinction centering are prior work, not a claimed new result.
Historical priority is based on specified inspected literature and searches, not comprehensive independent certification.
title: A marked Poisson shape law for disappearing three-vertex components in band random graphs
